cohort: 452 women with singleton pregnancies who underwent a 2-hour 75g oral glucose tolerance test between January 2006 and December 2010.
finding: Adopting stricter IADPSG diagnostic criteria for GDM increased its prevalence by 2.37-fold compared to JSOG criteria, reclassifying women with milder glucose abnormalities as GDM, and was associated with higher insulin resistance in non-obese women.
cross-section timing: Data collected between January 2006 and December 2010
